name: echo
description: Echo ID (row of the collection table of the radar database). Unique within a campaign (primary key).

name: echoID
description: Echo identifier combining the site ID and the echo number.

name: protocolID
description: ID of the measurement period (protocol) during which the echo was recorded. Links to protocol_data.

name: stc_level
description: STC level of the echo, used to calculate the MTR factors.

name: observation
description: Flag from the radar database indicating whether the echo has a manual observation.

name: human_classification
description: Class assigned by a human observer, if any.

name: observed_frequency
description: Wing-beat frequency recorded by a human observer, if any.

name: observed_direction
description: Flight direction recorded by a human observer, if any.

name: observed_speed
description: Flight speed recorded by a human observer, if any.

name: time_stamp_originTZ
description: Time of the echo in the radar time zone (see site_data timeZone_originTZ), written as local clock time.

name: time_stamp_targetTZ
description: Time of the echo in the target time zone (see site_data timeZone_targetTZ).

name: fs
description: Sampling frequency of the echo signal.

name: feature1.altitude_AGL
description: Altitude of the echo above ground level.

name: feature1.altitude_ASL
description: Altitude of the echo above sea level: feature1.altitude_AGL plus the altitude of the site (added by birdscanR).

name: feature2.azimuth
description: Azimuth (direction) of the echo, relative to true north. Only available when the antenna rotates.

name: feature6.rotationFreq
description: Rotation frequency of the radar antenna.

name: feature13.freqRatio
description: Frequency ratio of the echo signal.

name: feature14.maxLevel
description: Maximum level of the received signal.

name: feature17.rcs
description: Radar cross section (RCS) of the echo.

name: feature18.sqrt.RCS.
description: Square root of the radar cross section of the echo.

name: feature19.durationOfEcho
description: Duration of the echo.

name: feature20.durationOfEchoInSTC
description: Duration of the echo within the STC range.

name: feature24.alpha
description: Alpha: angle between the entry and exit angle of the echo in the detection range.

name: feature25.theta
description: Theta: 2 * EpsilonCalc.

name: feature30.altitudeLeftSideOfEcho
description: Altitude of the left side of the echo.

name: feature31.altitudeRightSideOfEcho
description: Altitude of the right side of the echo.

name: feature33.distLeftToBottom
description: Distance between the left side and the bottom of the echo.

name: feature34.nSamplesInEcho
description: Length of the echo.

name: feature35.areaOfEcho
description: Area of the echo (seconds multiplied by metres).

name: feature37.speed
description: Flight speed (available since BirdScan software v1.7; only when the antenna rotates). Unreasonable values are set to NA by filterSpeedFeature37(). Required for density calculations.

name: duration_sec
description: Random forest feature: duration of the echo signature.

name: std_sigRaw2
description: Random forest feature: standard deviation of the raw signal.

name: skw_sigRaw2
description: Random forest feature: skewness of the raw signal.

name: krt_sigRaw2
description: Random forest feature: kurtosis of the raw signal.

name: std_sigBP
description: Random forest feature: standard deviation of the band-passed signal.

name: skw_sigBP
description: Random forest feature: skewness of the band-passed signal.

name: krt_sigBP
description: Random forest feature: kurtosis of the band-passed signal.

name: shapeFeatures_1
description: Random forest feature (overall shape): minimum difference, between consecutive time chunks of the signal, of the chunk mean of the raw signal.

name: shapeFeatures_2
description: Random forest feature (overall shape): mean difference, between consecutive time chunks of the signal, of the chunk mean of the raw signal.

name: shapeFeatures_3
description: Random forest feature (overall shape): maximum difference, between consecutive time chunks of the signal, of the chunk mean of the raw signal.

name: shapeFeatures_4
description: Random forest feature (overall shape): minimum difference, between consecutive time chunks of the signal, of the chunk standard deviation of the band-passed signal.

name: shapeFeatures_5
description: Random forest feature (overall shape): mean difference, between consecutive time chunks of the signal, of the chunk standard deviation of the band-passed signal.

name: shapeFeatures_6
description: Random forest feature (overall shape): maximum difference, between consecutive time chunks of the signal, of the chunk standard deviation of the band-passed signal.

name: spec_entropy
description: Random forest feature: entropy of the STFT frequency spectrum of the high-pass power signal.

name: spec_mod_freq
description: Random forest feature: frequency of the maximum value of the STFT frequency spectrum of the high-pass power signal.

name: spec_mea_freq
description: Random forest feature: mean of the STFT frequency spectrum of the high-pass power signal.

name: spec_std_freq
description: Random forest feature: standard deviation of the STFT frequency spectrum of the high-pass power signal.

name: spec_skw_freq
description: Random forest feature: skewness of the STFT frequency spectrum of the high-pass power signal.

name: spec_krt_freq
description: Random forest feature: kurtosis of the STFT frequency spectrum of the high-pass power signal.

name: StftFreqOfHighestPeak
description: Random forest feature: frequency of the highest peak in the STFT frequency spectrum of the high-pass power signal.

name: StftRelHeightOfHighestPeak
description: Random forest feature: relative height of the highest peak in the STFT frequency spectrum of the high-pass power signal.

name: StftUniquenessOfHighestPeak
description: Random forest feature: uniqueness of the highest peak in the STFT frequency spectrum of the high-pass power signal.

name: StftInvVarOfPeakDiffs
description: Random forest feature: inverted variance of the frequency differences between the peaks detected in the STFT frequency spectrum of the high-pass power signal.

name: ^HPSfundFreHz\d+$
description: Random forest feature: fundamental frequency of the harmonic product spectrum of the STFT frequency spectrum, for the downsampling factor given by the number in the column name.

name: ^HPSentropy\d+$
description: Random forest feature: entropy of the harmonic product spectrum of the STFT frequency spectrum, for the downsampling factor given by the number in the column name.

name: ^BroadSpec_\d+$
description: Random forest feature: broad bin of the STFT frequency spectrum of the high-pass power signal (spectrum averaged into 30 broad bins); bin number given in the column name.

name: ACSineRegrFreq
description: Random forest feature: frequency of the best-fitting sine wave (least squares) to the autocorrelation of the high-pass power signal.

name: ACSineRegrError
description: Random forest feature: regression error of the best-fitting sine wave (least squares) to the autocorrelation of the high-pass power signal.

name: ACFirstPeakFreq
description: Random forest feature: frequency of the first peak of the autocorrelation of the high-pass power signal.

name: ACFirstPeakHeight
description: Random forest feature: height of the first peak of the autocorrelation of the high-pass power signal.

name: ACMaxPeakFreq
description: Random forest feature: frequency of the highest peak of the autocorrelation of the high-pass power signal.

name: ACMaxPeakHeight
description: Random forest feature: height of the highest peak of the autocorrelation of the high-pass power signal.

name: ACFirstPeakAboveZeroFreq
description: Random forest feature: frequency of the first peak above zero of the autocorrelation of the high-pass power signal.

name: ACFirstPeakAboveZeroHeight
description: Random forest feature: height of the first peak above zero of the autocorrelation of the high-pass power signal.

name: WFPf_proportionFeat_phase
description: Random forest feature (wing flapping packages): proportion of the signal duration classified as wing flapping.

name: WFPf_numP_phase
description: Random forest feature (wing flapping packages): number of wing-flapping packets.

name: WFPf_meadur_phase
description: Random forest feature (wing flapping packages): mean duration of the wing-flapping packets.

name: WFPf_cv_dur_std_phase
description: Random forest feature (wing flapping packages): standard deviation of the duration of the wing-flapping packets.

name: WFPf_numP_pause
description: Random forest feature (wing flapping packages): number of pause packets.

name: WFPf_meadur_pause
description: Random forest feature (wing flapping packages): mean duration of the pause packets.

name: WFPf_cv_dur_std_pause
description: Random forest feature (wing flapping packages): standard deviation of the duration of the pause packets.

name: ^ampliSpecFeat1_\d+$
description: Random forest feature (wing flapping packages): frequency bin of the STFT spectrum of the moving mean (0.15 s window) of the absolute band-passed signal; the lowest 28 bins are used, bin number given in the column name.

name: RCS2_RCS_nearest_fea14
description: Random forest feature: nearest RCS.

name: RCS2_RCS_max_lowpassed
description: Random forest feature: RCS of the maximum of the low-pass signal.

name: RCS2_RCS_max_rawsignal
description: Random forest feature: RCS of the maximum of the raw signal.

name: RCS2_RCS_mea_rawsignal
description: Random forest feature: RCS of the mean of the raw signal.

name: ^loHPSfundFreHz_\d+$
description: Random forest feature (low frequency): fundamental frequency of the harmonic product spectrum of the low-frequency spectrum, for the downsampling factor (1-4) given by the number in the column name.

name: ^loHPSentropy_\d+$
description: Random forest feature (low frequency): entropy of the harmonic product spectrum of the low-frequency spectrum, for the downsampling factor (1-4) given by the number in the column name.

name: ^spectrLowBins_\d+$
description: Random forest feature (low frequency): low frequency bin (1-11) of the STFT spectrum of the high-pass signal; bin number given in the column name.

name: ^spectrMedBins_\d+$
description: Random forest feature (low frequency): medium frequency bin of the STFT spectrum of the high-pass signal; bins of 2 Hz width between 4 and 50 Hz, bin number given in the column name.

name: shapeFeatPhi
description: Random forest feature (polarisation/shape): orientation (phi) of the model fitted to the normalised RCS over one antenna rotation. Only computed when the antenna rotates.

name: shapeFeatA0
description: Random forest feature (polarisation/shape): mean RCS (a0, about 1 after normalisation) of the model fitted to the normalised RCS over one antenna rotation. Only computed when the antenna rotates.

name: shapeFeatA2
description: Random forest feature (polarisation/shape): elongation (a2) of the model fitted to the normalised RCS over one antenna rotation. Only computed when the antenna rotates.

name: shapeFeatA4
description: Random forest feature (polarisation/shape): cruciform element (a4) of the model fitted to the normalised RCS over one antenna rotation. Only computed when the antenna rotates.

name: shapeFeatRegrErr
description: Random forest feature (polarisation/shape): regression error of the model fitted to the normalised RCS over one antenna rotation. Only computed when the antenna rotates.

name: WFF_predicted
description: Wing-beat frequency estimated by a random forest model.

name: WFF_credibility
description: Reliability (0-1) of the wing-beat frequency estimate in WFF_predicted.

name: ChapRatio
description: Random forest feature computed by the BirdScan software (not further documented).

name: polRatioNew
description: Random forest feature computed by the BirdScan software: polarisation ratio (not further documented).

name: fundFreqQualMax
description: Random forest feature computed by the BirdScan software: fundamental frequency quality, maximum (not further documented).

name: fundFreqQualMea
description: Random forest feature computed by the BirdScan software: fundamental frequency quality, mean (not further documented).

name: fundFreqValHz
description: Random forest feature computed by the BirdScan software: fundamental frequency (not further documented).

name: echoValidationType
description: Label from the echo validator: 'bio scatterer' or 'non-bio scatterer'. Not available for databases reclassified with BirdScan versions older than v1.6.

name: class
description: Class assigned by the random forest classifier (e.g. insect, passerine_type, nonbio).

name: mtr_factor_rf
description: MTR factor based on the random forest class: number of objects per hour and km represented by the echo. It depends on the size of the object (RCS); for small RCS, the typical size of the class is used instead.

name: class_probability
description: Probability of the class assigned by the random forest classifier.

name: mtr_factor_sphereDiaCm
description: Sphere diameter used to calculate mtr_factor_rf: derived from the RCS, or the typical size of the class when the RCS is small. 0 for nonbio and precipitation.

name: classifierVersion
description: Version of the random forest classifier.

name: batClass
description: Class assigned by the bat classifier ('bat' or 'nonbat').

name: bat_mtr_factor_rf
description: MTR factor of the echo for its bat class: number of objects per hour and km represented by the echo.

name: bat_class_probability
description: Probability of the class assigned by the bat classifier.

name: bat_mtr_factor_sphereDiaCm
description: Diameter of the reference sphere of the bat class, used to compute bat_mtr_factor_rf.

name: batClassifierVersion
description: Version of the bat classifier.

name: dayOrNight
description: Diel period of the echo: 'day' or 'night' (see sunrise_sunset).

name: dayOrCrepOrNight
description: Diel period of the echo: 'day', 'crepusculeMorning', 'crepusculeEvening' or 'night' (see sunrise_sunset).

name: dateSunset
description: Time of the sunset that ends the day or starts the night the echo belongs to. Used to group echoes by diel period.

name: protocolID
description: ID of the measurement period (protocol). A new protocol starts at each change of the operation mode of the radar (pulse type, rotation, ...). Primary key, linked to echo_data and blind_times.

name: siteID
description: Site ID. Links to site_data.

name: startTime_originTZ
description: Start of the measurement period in the radar time zone, written as local clock time.

name: startTime_targetTZ
description: Start of the measurement period in the target time zone (since 2020 usually UTC).

name: stopTime_originTZ
description: End of the measurement period in the radar time zone, written as local clock time.

name: stopTime_targetTZ
description: End of the measurement period in the target time zone (since 2020 usually UTC).

name: pulseType
description: Operation mode, pulse type: 'S' short, 'M' medium or 'L' long pulse. See site_data for the pulse duration.

name: rotate
description: Operation mode, antenna rotation: 1 when the radar is in rotation mode, 0 when not. Flight speed and direction are only available when the antenna rotates.

name: stc
description: STC altitude: altitude up to which the sensitivity time control applies. Key parameter for the MTR factor of an echo.

name: threshold
description: STC threshold. Key parameter for the MTR factor of an echo.

name: blockTime
description: Time the radar is blind after a protocol change (start of the measurement period). Recorded as blind time of type 'protocolChange' in blind_times.

name: softwareVersion
description: Radar software version during the measurement period. Can differ from the classifier version.

name: type
description: Type of blind time: 'protocolChange' (block time after the start of a measurement period), 'visibility' (blind time registered by the radar, due to weather such as rain, snow or heavy fog, or clutter such as a radome covered with snow or leaves or nearby objects), or a manual type (free text, e.g. 'rain', 'tech', 'clutter'). Blind times are used to compute the effective observation time per time bin; when computing MTR, some types (e.g. rain) can instead be treated as observation time with MTR zero (argument blindTimeAsMtrZero of computeObservationTime()).

name: start_targetTZ
description: Start of the blind time in the target time zone.

name: stop_targetTZ
description: End of the blind time in the target time zone.

name: protocolID
description: ID of the measurement period the blind time overlaps with (first overlapping period). Empty if it overlaps with none. Links to protocol_data.

name: is_night
description: 0 for a day period, 1 for a night period.

name: date
description: Date of the event (target time zone).

name: sunStart
description: Time of sunrise (target time zone), at the site location.

name: sunStop
description: Time of sunset (target time zone), at the site location.

name: civilStart
description: Time of dawn (civil twilight, sun 6 degrees below the horizon), target time zone.

name: civilStop
description: Time of dusk (civil twilight, sun 6 degrees below the horizon), target time zone.

name: nauticalStart
description: Time of dawn (nautical twilight, sun 12 degrees below the horizon), target time zone.

name: nauticalStop
description: Time of dusk (nautical twilight, sun 12 degrees below the horizon), target time zone.

name: radarID
description: Radar ID (links to the radar table of the radar database).

name: siteID
description: Site ID. Primary key.

name: siteCode
description: Three-letter abbreviation of the site name.

name: siteName
description: Name of the site.

name: siteDesc
description: Description of the site.

name: timeZone_originTZ
description: Time zone set on the radar (Olson name); used for all *_originTZ columns. Always UTC for data recorded with BirdScan software v1.6 and higher.

name: timeZone_targetTZ
description: Time zone used for the analyses (Olson name, usually UTC); used for all *_targetTZ columns.

name: projectStart_originTZ
description: Start date of the project (campaign) in the radar time zone, written as local clock time.

name: projectStart_targetTZ
description: Start date of the project (campaign) in the target time zone.

name: projectEnd_originTZ
description: End date of the project (campaign) in the radar time zone, written as local clock time.

name: projectEnd_targetTZ
description: End date of the project (campaign) in the target time zone.

name: longitude
description: Longitude of the site, in decimal degrees.

name: latitude
description: Latitude of the site, in decimal degrees.

name: altitude
description: Altitude of the site above sea level.

name: radarOrientation
description: Orientation of the radar to north at the site (from the site table of the radar database; differs from northOffset, which is stored with the radar unit).

name: customer
description: Radar operator.

name: type
description: Radar type, e.g. BirdScanMR1 (Swiss Birdradar Solution).

name: serialNo
description: Serial number of the radar.

name: northOffset
description: Radar parameter: north offset (from the radar table of the radar database, i.e. stored with the radar unit; differs from radarOrientation, which is stored with the site).

name: delta
description: Radar parameter: delta.

name: tiltAngle
description: Radar parameter: tilt angle. Constant for BirdScan MR1.

name: transmitPower
description: Radar parameter: transmitted power. Can vary between years when the magnetron is replaced.

name: antennaGainInDBi
description: Radar parameter: antenna gain. Constant for BirdScan MR1.

name: waveGuideAttenuation
description: Radar parameter: wave guide attenuation. Constant for BirdScan MR1.

name: ^(short|medium|long)0V$
description: Calibration parameter of the pulse type (short, medium or long): 0V level.

name: ^(short|medium|long)SatLower$
description: Calibration parameter of the pulse type (short, medium or long): lower saturation.

name: ^(short|medium|long)Steepness$
description: Calibration parameter of the pulse type (short, medium or long): steepness.

name: ^(short|medium|long)SatUpper$
description: Calibration parameter of the pulse type (short, medium or long): upper saturation.

name: ^pulseLength(Short|Medium|Long)$
description: Pulse length of the pulse type (short, medium or long). Determines the range resolution.
